name: nostr-bray
description: Trust-aware Nostr for AI agents: read feeds, profiles, relays and web-of-trust scores, and post, message and zap through a NIP-46 signer. Runs read-only until a signer is configured.

BUNKER_URI.title: NIP-46 signer (optional)
BUNKER_URI.description: A bunker:// URI from your signer, to let bray post, message and zap. Your key stays in the signer. Leave empty to run read-only.

NOSTR_PUBKEY.title: Read as npub (optional)
NOSTR_PUBKEY.description: Read-only mode only: an npub whose notifications and contacts bray can read. Never paste a secret key here.
